entities.title: Tests
entities.summary: The two test projects of the C# library: Utv.Tests (fixtures, conformance material, the JSON and typed layers) and Utv.Examples.Tests (the examples, written as unit tests).
entities.purpose: Holds every automated check of the library. Both projects are xUnit test projects on net8.0 that reference src/Utv/Utv.csproj, and dotnet test in implementations/csharp runs both through Utv.sln.
boundaries: What each test class checks is recorded in the verification files of the test folders, which link to the views and contracts they verify.
Tests read the shared material in schema/ and conformance/ in place; nothing is copied into this folder.
No CI workflow runs these tests; .github/workflows/validate.yml runs only the repository's Python checks.
